title: Digital Travel Agent v2 — Full Booking & Management Flow (v1.6)
description: Complete travel agent using v1.6 elements: Icon, Badge, CompoundButton, Table. Main menu with CompoundButtons for booking wizard (6 steps: trip details, flights, lodging, transport, dinner, confirm+pay) and change/cancel sub-flows for flights, lodging, restaurants. Uses Action.ToggleVisibility for in-card navigation with back + main menu buttons. Demonstrates modern v1.6 patterns: Icon element for inline icons, Badge for status labels, CompoundButton for rich menu items with description+icon, Table for transport pricing grid.
use_cases: End-to-end trip booking with flight search, lodging, transport, and dinner
Multi-step wizard with back and main menu navigation using ToggleVisibility
Change or cancel existing flight booking with date picker and alternative flights
Change or cancel hotel or AirBnB stay
Main menu using CompoundButton for rich option cards with icons and descriptions
Review and payment confirmation with itemized cost breakdown
Demo mode with realistic mocked data for all API integrations
Consistent header bar with Icon + Badge across all screens
Table element for structured transport pricing data

notes: v2 of the Digital Travel Agent using Adaptive Cards v1.6 features. Key differences from v1: uses Icon element (not Image URLs) for inline icons, Badge element for 'Demo mode' label in header, CompoundButton for rich menu items with title+description+icon (instead of plain ActionSet), Table element for Uber transport pricing grid (instead of FactSet). Navigation pattern: every screen has consistent ColumnSet header (Icon + title + Badge), action row at bottom with Continue/Back/Main Menu in a ColumnSet layout. All sections hidden by default via isVisible:false.
